mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an easing monetary policy, which reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite FEDFUNDS decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 7.8% indicates a weakening labor market, which signals reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 7.8, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in housing starts and retail sales signals a broad-based demand slowdown, which triggers reduced corporate revenue expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for joint signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a decline in industrial production below 98.0 signals supply constraints that reduce corporate profit margins, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 98.0 during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC for regime-specific signal is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly real GDP growth signals robust economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production above 100.0 (indicating output above 2017 levels) signals strong supply capacity utilization that supports corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO > 100.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in total nonfarm employment below 134,000 thousand persons signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS < 134000.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 0.20% signals imminent monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.20, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
